title: President Marcos bids farewell to outgoing Sri Lankan envoy
summary: President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. bid farewell to Sri Lankan Ambassador to the Philippines, who concludes his tour of duty on Saturday, October 31, 2026.

blocks.text: President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. bid farewell to Sri Lankan Ambassador to the Philippines, who concludes his tour of duty on Saturday, October 31, 2026.
His Excellency Chanaka Harsha Talpahewa was at Malacañan Palace on Wednesday, according to the Presidential Communications Office (PCO).

"During his tenure, Ambassador Talpahewa helped deepen Philippines-Sri Lanka relations, including facilitating Sri Lanka's first investments in the Philippines through Haycarb PLC, a leading activated carbon manufacturer, and Jaindi Exports, a coconut processing company, with investments established in the Visayas and Mindanao," the PCO said.
Ambassador Talpahewa was conferred the Order of Sikatuna with the rank of Grand Cross (Datu), Silver Distinction.
This was in recognition of his contributions to bilateral relations, dedicated service in international relations, and efforts to promote economic and cultural ties. — BAP, GMA News
